prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is near, grab it, check its properties, do task. Else, move forward or turn around. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = TurnAround    /> <Action ID = MoveForward    /> <SubTree ID = PerformTask    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectInProximity    /> <Condition ID = IsPathBlocked    /> <Condition ID = IsPathClear    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectInProximity? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO PerformTask
	END
